Title: Minotaurs Mask
Description:
This collection consists of artworks executed on Arches paper using a variety of artistic materials and techniques. The series explores **masks inspired by the image of the Minotaur**, the mythical creature with the head of a bull, symbolizing masculinity, virility, and fertility. These masks are worn by different individuals—men, gentle and solitary figures, and even women—suggesting the multiplicity of human identities and the intersection of symbols associated with strength, fertility, and instinct.

Title: Crying Man
Description:
This collection consists of artworks executed on **French Canson paper**, using various artistic materials and techniques, under the title **“Crying Man.”**

The collection was created in remembrance and tribute to the artist **Ismail Fattah Al-Turk**, honoring his artistic legacy and his devotion to art and humanity. These works were inspired by the memory of the last conversation I had with him over the phone, when he was crying, sharing with me the pain of the tragic illness that eventually took him from us. His beautiful legacy, however, remains forever alive in the souls of those who knew him.

The collection comprises five artworks, each measuring **37.5 × 50 cm**. The works are preserved in a paper box envelope handmade and designed by the artist. All five works are signed, stamped, and dated by the artist.

Title: Delliances Love 1
Description:
This is the **first group** of artworks in the series titled **“Delliances Love.”** The series is composed of four groups, all presented under a single overarching title.

The works were executed on **canvas** using various artistic materials and techniques. The subject revolves around a man and a woman united by love, seeking to sustain their bond through playful affection that brings vitality and joy to their relationship. This idea is expressed through a variety of symbolic forms, including the heart, the bull’s head, the masked face of the man, the clown’s mask, and other forms that intertwine between the two figures, stirring emotions and breaking monotony. Through these elements, the works explore the continuation of love, the preservation of intimate affection, and the strengthening of the bond that forms the foundation between a man and a woman, making their love enduring and eternal for as long as they remain together.

This group is designated **No. 1 of “Delliances Love”** and comprises four artworks, each measuring **33 × 43 cm**. The works are mounted on paper measuring **50 × 70 cm**, which is printed with a **raised relief** framing the four artworks.

All the works are preserved in a paper envelope handmade and designed by the artist, and are signed and dated by the artist.
